# MedGPT

> MedGPT is an AI-powered educational health companion that helps patients decode and understand complex medical reports, complete blood count (CBC) panels, radiology findings, and prescription side effects.

## Main Product & Platform

- [MedGPT Web Application](https://medgptai.droploop.in): Official web portal and educational health assistant.
- [Google Play Application](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.medgptai.app): Android native mobile app for scanning and explaining medical records.

## Core Clinical Capabilities

- **Blood Test Analysis**: Automated breakdown of CBC, metabolic panels, liver function tests (ALT, AST, ALP), kidney panels (eGFR, Creatinine, BUN), and lipid panels.
- **Radiology Report Interpretation**: Decoding medical terminology across X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, and ultrasounds.
- **Medication & Drug Safety**: Understanding prescription indications, side effects, contraindications, and food-drug interactions.
- **Multilingual Support**: Real-time localization across 25 languages with regional healthcare system integration (e.g., German ePA, Polish NFZ, Russian OMI, Czech VZP).

## Key Health Education Guides

- [Health Blog Index](https://medgptai.droploop.in/blog): Complete library of evidence-based patient guides.
- [How to Read Blood Test Results](https://medgptai.droploop.in/blog/how-to-read-blood-test-results): Foundational reference guide to understanding lab values, reference ranges, and units.
- [Understanding CBC & Differential](https://medgptai.droploop.in/blog/understanding-cbc-differential-wbc-types): Detailed explanation of white blood cells, neutrophils, and immune markers.
- [Kidney Function Test Guide](https://medgptai.droploop.in/blog/how-to-read-kidney-function-test-results): Interpreting eGFR, creatinine, and kidney health stages.
- [Liver Function Test Guide](https://medgptai.droploop.in/blog/understanding-liver-function-test-results): Transaminases (ALT, AST) and biliary enzymes explained.
- [Czech Healthcare & Krevní Obraz Guide](https://medgptai.droploop.in/blog/czech-healthcare-krevni-obraz-guide): Navigating Czech blood tests, žádanka requisitions, and VZP health insurance.
- [German Healthcare & Blutbild Guide](https://medgptai.droploop.in/blog/german-healthcare-blutbild-epa-guide): Accessing blood test data via Germany's electronic patient record (ePA).
- [Polish Healthcare & Badania Krwi Guide](https://medgptai.droploop.in/blog/polish-healthcare-badania-krwi-guide): Understanding Polish blood tests and NFZ primary care POZ referrals.

## Important Policies & Ethics

- [Privacy Policy](https://medgptai.droploop.in/privacy): HIPAA-aligned, zero-data-retention architectural principles.
- [Terms of Service](https://medgptai.droploop.in/terms): User agreement and educational boundaries.

## Medical Disclaimer

MedGPT is an educational tool designed to improve health literacy and prepare patients for doctor visits. It does not provide medical diagnosis, clinical prognosis, or direct treatment advice. Always consult a licensed healthcare professional for medical emergencies and clinical evaluations.
